label: Intuitionism: excluded middle is not a law of logic. p ∨ ¬p may be asserted…, by Constructive-proof
meaning: Asserting p ∨ ¬p requires proving it, and proving it is proving p or ¬p; an undecided proposition's instance is therefore not asserted; and every instance's denial is refuted, since every instance is irrefutable.
